JIM'S PEST CONTROL

What Pest Can We Help With Australia Wide? All Of Them!

ANTS

Are you tired of finding persistent trails of ants?

We use targeted, effective ant control treatments to eradicate colonies whether it is black ants or coastal brown ants or any other ant species.

BEES

Have you discovered a dangerous bee nest or an aggressive swarm near your home or business? Bees are vital to the environment, and our primary commitment is always to safe, humane bee removal and relocation where feasible, connecting them with local beekeepers. When a nest is too inaccessible or poses an extreme, immediate threat, our licensed technicians provide fast, targeted bee control to safely secure your property while maintaining a focus on environmental responsibility.

TERMITES

Need a professional Termite Inspection to check for termite damage? Don't risk your home. If active pests are found, our licensed experts provide termite extermination and long-lasting termite treatment to eliminate the entire colony. Schedule your termite inspection and termite management plan today.

BIRDS

Tired of damaging bird droppings, noise, and nesting pigeons ruining your property's appearance? Birds, especially pigeons and seagulls, create costly messes and pose serious health risks on roofs, solar panels, and balconies. We provide professional, humane bird proofing solutions, including discreet bird netting and bird spiking installation, to eliminate perching and nesting. Get effective, long-term bird control and protect your investment today!

COCKROACHES

Are you tired of finding cockroaches contaminating your kitchen or struggling with a German Cockroach infestation? Cockroaches are resilient, carry disease, and breed rapidly, making DIY efforts ineffective. Our licensed experts provide fast, targeted cockroach extermination using professional baiting and residual treatments to eliminate the entire infestation. Get guaranteed, long-term cockroach control and reclaim your home today!

RODENTS

Rats & Mice

Scratching in the ceiling at night? Rodents cause serious structural damage and carry disease that puts your family at risk. Jim's licensed technicians identify the species, eliminate the infestation and proof your property against return — all backed by a documented service certificate and APVMA-compliant treatments.

[Learn More →]

WASPS

Is a dangerous, aggressive wasp nest putting your family or customers at risk? Don't attempt risky DIY solutions. Wasps, including Yellow Jackets and European Wasps, can deliver painful, repeated stings. Our licensed experts provide fast, safe wasp nest removal and complete wasp extermination using targeted treatments that eliminate the entire colony at the source, securing your property immediately.

SPIDERS

Are venomous Redback or deadly Funnel-web spiders setting up danger zones around your home? Australia is home to some unique spider threats. Our licensed technicians provide specialized, full-coverage spider control and spider extermination that targets the entire infestation, including frightening but common visitors like the Huntsman and the problematic White-tail spiders. We safely treat all internal and external harbourage points to give you lasting protection and peace of mind. Ask us about bundling your spider treatment with a comprehensive general pest control plan.

AND MORE...

Residential Pest Control Services Across Australia

Your home should be a safe and comfortable sanctuary — but unwanted pests such as termites, rodents, spiders and cockroaches can threaten your family’s health and cause costly structural damage. Jim’s Pest Control provides professional residential pest control services across Australia, including termite inspections, termite treatments and comprehensive home pest management solutions.

Our licensed technicians deliver targeted pest control treatments for active infestations and implement long-lasting preventative pest barriers to protect your property year-round. Whether you require specialised termite protection, an annual termite inspection or general household pest control, we ensure your home remains secure, compliant and pest-free.

Commercial Pest Control Services Across Australia

A pest infestation in a commercial environment — whether a restaurant, warehouse, office, hospitality venue or retail space — can severely impact your reputation, compliance status and revenue. Jim’s Pest Control provides professional commercial pest control services designed to meet strict Australian health regulations and industry compliance standards.

Our licensed commercial pest technicians deliver proactive business pest management programs, including scheduled inspections, detailed reporting, preventative treatments and ongoing maintenance plans. From food safety compliance to workplace pest control requirements, we help businesses across Australia stay protected, compliant and fully operational.
